how: Signals score each side from line moves at both books, the model projection, rest, home court, form and average margin.
A pick is made only when the game fits a rule that is on.
Rule status follows the Season Cards policy: on while season and this month are green; backtest failures turn on automatically when green (Trina, Nov 6).
Picks grade Thin early in the season while ratings lean on last season.
notes: Nov 02: Starting settings from the backtest; ROAD1DAY_FADE live (approved). Nov 03: EARLY_UNDER_OPEN live (approved), held on through Nov 8. Nov 06: Season Cards policy applied: backtest failures turn on automatically when green (Trina). DOG_ML on (2-1, +2.20u). UNDER_DROP variant moved to lowered (re-check). 191 games played this season through 2026-11-05.

text: A rule is active only while its season to date and this month are both in the green (positive units).
Timing is unchanged: a rule can only switch off once it has 20+ season picks. The month counts once it has 5+ picks.
A rule turns off when its season units go negative, or this month goes negative on 5+ picks.
An inactive rule keeps being graded on every game it fits and turns back on when season and month are both green, including rules that failed the 3-season backtest (Trina, Nov 6).
EARLY_UNDER_OPEN is held on through Nov 8 (Trina); from Nov 9 the policy decides.
